Author: notingway
Name: Duty Notes
Description: An in-game overlay that holds your notes for a duty: a table of mechanics, the mitigation and healing actions to use for each (shown as icons), notes, and free text. Encounters can be tied to a duty and a job so the right one appears when you enter, with phases you can step through from buttons or macros.
Punchline: Per-duty overlay for mechanics, mitigation and notes.
Changelog: Fixes the overlay running off the screen when Show full encounter is switched off.
